articles.title: Recap: BOJ's Himino calls for 'timely' rate hikes to curb inflation
articles.expand: Himino's direct call for "timely" rate hikes, delivered in his own words rather than through analyst interpretation, sharpens the hawkish read markets had already been building around this speech. His framing of the choice as timely, gradual tightening versus a future spike requiring abrupt hikes gives the BOJ a clear rationale for moving sooner rather than later, and reinforces September as a live meeting. The explicit flag on yen weakness as an accelerant to inflation keeps FX front and centre in the BOJ's reaction function, with any further yen softness now more directly linked to hike risk...
